रिप्सु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid), wishing to seize
or take hold of, &c.

रिप् 1. रिप् (the old form of rt. लिप्, q. v.;
in Ṛg-veda

. the form रिरिपुः
= लेपयन्ति = पापम् आरोपयन्ति), Ved. to smear,
smear or cover over; to defile, spoil; to deceive,
cheat.

2. रिप्, प्, f., Ved. injury, fraud, deceit, trick,
guile, (Sāy. = हिंसा, माया); the earth, (Sāy. =
[]
भूमि); (प्, प्, प्), injuring, an injurer, enemy,
deceiver, cheat, (Sāy. = रिपु.)
रिपु, उस्, उस्, उ (according to Uṇādi-s.

. fr.
rt. रप्; according to others, connected with rt. 1. रि
or with Caus. of rt. 1. री; cf. rt. रिफ्), injuring,
cheating, deceiving, fraudulent, treacherous, false
(Ved.); (उस्), m. a deceiver, cheat, rogue, thief
(Ved.); an enemy, adversary, foe; (in astrology) a
hostile planet; epithet of the sixth astrological house;
N. of a son of Śliṣṭi.
—रिपु-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
slaying an enemy, killing foes; (इनी), f. a species of
creeper; Abrus Precatorius.
—रिपु-घ्न, अस्, ई,
अम्, killing an enemy.
—रिपुञ्-जय, अस्, आ, अम्,
conquering a foe, vanquishing enemies; (अस्), m.,
N. of several kings; of a son of Śliṣṭi; of a son
of Suvīra; of a son of Viśva-jit.
—रिपु-ता, f. en-
mity, hostility.
—रिपु-निपातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, causing
an enemy to fall, destroying a foe.
—रिपु-बल,
अम्, n. an enemy's army.
—रिपु-भय, अम्, n.
fear or danger from an enemy.
—रिपु-भवन,
अम्, n. or रिपु-भाव, अस्, m. epithet of the sixth
astrological house.
—रिपु-मल्ल, अस्, m., N. of a
king.
—रिपु-रक्त, अम्, n. an enemy's blood.
—रिपु-रक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, preserving from an
enemy.
—रिपु-राक्षस, अस्, m., N. of an
elephant.
—रिपु-वर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from
an enemy.
—रिपु-वश, अस्, आ, अम्, subject to an
enemy.
—रिपुवश-त्व, अम्, n. subjection to an
enemy.
—रिपु-सूदन, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying ene-
mies.
—रिपु-स्थान, अम्, n. epithet of the sixth
astrological house.

रिप्त, अस्, आ, अम् (= लिप्त), Ved. anointed,
smeared, (अपि-रिप्त in Ṛg-veda

= पट-
लेन पिहित-दृष्टि, i. e. blinded.)

); (अस्, आ, अम्), vile, bad; (अस्),
m., N. of a son of Śliṣṭi.
—रिप्र-वाह, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. carrying off or removing impurity or sin,
(Sāy. = पापस्य वोढृ.)
